checks: health endpoints separate liveness from readiness
security headers are set on pages and APIs
public auth config exposes no secrets
password recovery responds identically for known and unknown emails
invitation → acceptance over HTTP sets a hardened session cookie with the invited role
users list and revoke their own sessions; revoking another user’s session is 404
device registration returns a one-time key; ingestion uses bearer keys, not cookies
telemetry queries label real and simulated data and never mix them
managers upload evidence over multipart; downloads are private, typed and non-sniffable
unassigned technicians and operators cannot list, read or upload evidence
uploads reject cross-origin, oversized, mismatched and non-multipart requests
deletion requires a reason and is reflected in the campus audit log
model usage summary reports demo mode honestly
